title: Two Exercises in Formal Composition
edition_version: Version of record unless otherwise noted
relevance: Two complementary exercises show how to explore families of shapes: start with elements and allowable relations, or start with a drawing and infer rules that generate it and related drawings.
prerequisites: Elementary sets and functions; some proof reading

license_redistribution.conditions: No public redistribution permission verified; citation and lawful reading link only.

locators.locator: pp. 188–194, §2: shape, spatial relations and grammars

verification.scope: Primary paper: definitions in §2, both exercises in §3, and conclusions; selected illustrated constructions. The central framework and both exercises were reviewed. The many illustrated rule variants were sampled rather than exhaustively checked.
